claim: CRISPR-Cas9 uses a guide RNA to target specific DNA sequences for editing.
gold_evidence_sentences: The type II prokaryotic CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats)/Cas adaptive immune system has been shown to facilitate RNA-guided site-specific DNA cleavage.

We engineered two different type II CRISPR/Cas systems and demonstrate that Cas9 nucleases can be directed by short RNAs to induce precise cleavage at endogenous genomic loci in human and mouse cells.
verification_source: Cong et al., Science 2013 (PMID 23287718); Jinek et al., Science 2012 (PMID 22745249); Indexed Corpus Doc 461550

claim: Antibiotics eliminate influenza viruses by disrupting their bacterial cell walls.
verification_source: CDC Influenza Clinical Guidance (2024); Murray et al., Medical Microbiology 9th Ed (Influenza is an enveloped orthomyxovirus lacking peptidoglycan cell walls; antibacterial agents have zero efficacy against influenza virions)

claim: Every genetic variant identified by genome sequencing causes a disease.
gold_evidence_sentences: There are several common polymorphisms in the BRCA1 gene which generate amino acid substitutions.
Common variants in BRCA1 are not associated with a substantial increase in breast or ovarian cancer risk.
verification_source: 1000 Genomes Project Consortium, Nature 2015 (PMID 26432245); ACMG Guidelines 2015; Indexed Corpus Doc 17088791

claim: The hippocampus contributes to the formation of certain types of new memories.
verification_source: Scoville & Milner, JNNP 1957 (PMID 13406589); Squire et al., Annu Rev Neurosci 2004; Kandel et al., Principles of Neural Science 5th Ed

claim: All patients with breast cancer carry a BRCA1 mutation.
gold_evidence_sentences: RESULTS Of the 491 patients with identified breast cancers, 391 patients were BRCA negative, and 86 patients were BRCA positive.
verification_source: Gonzalez-Angulo et al., J Clin Oncol 2011 (PMID 21300931); Couch et al., JAMA 2017; Indexed Corpus Doc 3285322

claim: A scientific study's association between two variables necessarily proves causation.
verification_source: Bradford Hill Criteria, Proc R Soc Med 1965; Pearl, Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference (Cambridge University Press, 2009)

claim: Messenger RNA vaccines provide cells with instructions for producing a target antigen.
verification_source: Pardi et al., Nat Rev Drug Discov 2018 (PMID 29326432); Polack et al., NEJM 2020 (PMID 33301246); Kariko et al., Mol Ther 2008

claim: All bacteria are harmful to humans.
gold_evidence_sentences: The gastrointestinal tracts of mammals are colonized by hundreds of microbial species that contribute to health, including colonization resistance against intestinal pathogens.
verification_source: Buffie et al., Nature 2015 (PMID 25337874); Human Microbiome Project Consortium, Nature 2012; Indexed Corpus Doc 4465735

claim: DNA sequencing can identify genetic variants without proving that every identified variant causes disease.
gold_evidence_sentences: There are several common polymorphisms in the BRCA1 gene which generate amino acid substitutions.
Common variants in BRCA1 are not associated with a substantial increase in breast or ovarian cancer risk.
verification_source: Biesecker & Green, NEJM 2014 (PMID 24941179); Richards et al., ACMG Standards, Genet Med 2015 (PMID 25741868); Indexed Corpus Doc 17088791

claim: A single observational study always establishes that a treatment is effective.
verification_source: Concato et al., NEJM 2000 (PMID 10861081); Guyatt et al., GRADE Guidelines, J Clin Epidemiol 2011; Grimes & Schulz, Lancet 2002

claim: Solar ultraviolet B radiation stimulates cutaneous synthesis of vitamin D precursors in the skin.
gold_evidence_sentences: During exposure to sunlight, the solar ultraviolet B photons (290-315 nm) penetrate into the skin where they cause the photolysis of 7-dehydrocholesterol to precholecalciferol.
verification_source: Holick, Am J Clin Nutr 1994 (PMID 8129377); Holick, NEJM 2007 (PMID 17634462); Indexed Corpus Doc 275294

claim: Topical application of sunscreen enhances the cutaneous production of cholecalciferol.
gold_evidence_sentences: An increase in skin pigmentation, aging, and the topical application of a sunscreen diminishes the cutaneous production of cholecalciferol.
verification_source: Holick, Am J Clin Nutr 1994 (PMID 8129377); Indexed Corpus Doc 275294

claim: MicroRNA-375 inhibits autophagy in hepatocellular carcinoma cells under hypoxic conditions by suppressing ATG7.
gold_evidence_sentences: The ability of miR-375 to inhibit autophagy was independent of its ability to regulate 3'-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase-1-AKT-mammalian target of rapamycin signaling, but instead involved suppression of ATG7, an autophagy-associated gene.
CONCLUSIONS miR-375 inhibits autophagy by reducing expression of ATG7 and impairs viability of HCC cells under hypoxic conditions in culture and in mice.
verification_source: Chang et al., Gastroenterology 2012 (PMID 22683935); Indexed Corpus Doc 982650

claim: MicroRNA-375 expression promotes the growth and viability of hepatocellular carcinoma cells under hypoxia.
gold_evidence_sentences: Up-regulating miR-375 or down-regulating ATG7 inhibited mitochondrial autophagy of HCC cells, reduced the elimination of damaged mitochondria under hypoxia, increased release of mitochondrial apoptotic proteins, and reduced viability of HCC cells.
CONCLUSIONS miR-375 inhibits autophagy by reducing expression of ATG7 and impairs viability of HCC cells under hypoxic conditions in culture and in mice.
verification_source: Chang et al., Gastroenterology 2012 (PMID 22683935); Indexed Corpus Doc 982650

claim: Propranolol administration prevents stress-induced microglial reactivity and macrophage trafficking to the brain.
gold_evidence_sentences: The stress-dependent changes in microglia and macrophages were prevented by propranolol, a β-adrenergic receptor antagonist.
verification_source: Wohleb et al., J Neurosci 2011 (PMID 22171033); Indexed Corpus Doc 2436602

claim: The alternative lengthening of telomeres mechanism allows certain cancer cells to maintain telomeres in the absence of active telomerase.
gold_evidence_sentences: The alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) mechanism allows cancer cells to escape senescence and apoptosis in the absence of active telomerase.
verification_source: Osterwald et al., Mol Cell Biol 2015 (PMID 26344565); Bryan et al., Nat Med 1997; Indexed Corpus Doc 213017

claim: Active telomerase expression is strictly required for all human cancer cells to maintain telomere length.
gold_evidence_sentences: The alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT) mechanism allows cancer cells to escape senescence and apoptosis in the absence of active telomerase.
verification_source: Osterwald et al., Mol Cell Biol 2015 (PMID 26344565); Dunham et al., Nat Genet 2000; Indexed Corpus Doc 213017

claim: Antibiotic treatment can disrupt intestinal commensal microbiota and increase vulnerability to Clostridium difficile infection.
gold_evidence_sentences: Many antibiotics destroy intestinal microbial communities and increase susceptibility to intestinal pathogens.
Among these, Clostridium difficile, a major cause of antibiotic-induced diarrhoea, greatly increases morbidity and mortality in hospitalized patients.
verification_source: Buffie et al., Nature 2015 (PMID 25337874); Indexed Corpus Doc 4465735

claim: High-dose oral vitamin C supplementation effectively cures established metastatic lung carcinoma in humans.
verification_source: Moertel et al., NEJM 1985 (PMID 3880514); Jacobs et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2015; NCI PDQ High-Dose Vitamin C Evidence Summary

claim: Routine whole-body MRI screening in asymptomatic young adults improves overall life expectancy.
verification_source: US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) Screening Evidence Reviews; Schmidt et al., Lancet Oncol 2018; American College of Radiology Appropriateness Criteria

claim: Consuming moderate amounts of dark chocolate prevents the development of Alzheimer's disease.
verification_source: Alzheimer's Association Evidence Brief (2023); Rutledge et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2017; While cocoa flavanols exhibit antioxidant properties in vitro, clinical human trials lack sufficient evidence to establish Alzheimer's prevention

claim: Extracellular vesicles isolated from plant fluids cross the human blood-brain barrier to reverse neurodegeneration.
verification_source: van Niel et al., Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol 2018 (PMID 29339798); Exploratory preclinical hypothesis lacking verified clinical proof or systematic human trial evidence

claim: Regular mindfulness meditation practice completely eliminates cerebral cortex atrophy during aging.
verification_source: Fjell et al., Ann NY Acad Sci 2014 (PMID 24697728); Luders et al., Front Aging Neurosci 2015; Normal human cortical senescence involves inevitable loss of gray matter volume, synaptic density, and glial structure that meditation cannot completely eliminate

claim: Specific maternal dietary microbiome alterations during the first trimester can completely eradicate childhood asthma risk.
verification_source: Vael et al., Lancet 2011; GINA Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention 2023; Childhood asthma has multifactorial genetic and environmental etiology; complete risk eradication via maternal dietary microbiome alterations is unevidenced
